
{{alias}}( x, offset )
    Returns a Uint32Array view of a Uint64Array.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: Uint64Array
        Input array.

    offset: integer
        Starting index of the view relative to the Uint64Array.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Uint32Array
        Uint32Array view.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/uint64}}( 10 );
    > var out = {{alias}}( x, 0 )
    <Uint32Array>
    > var bool = ( out.buffer === x.buffer )
    true

    See Also
    --------
